text: The team will review the working design before the next meeting.
Marketing Expert will produce mock-ups and general ideas.
There is no agreement yet on multi-system support and a decision is required before proceeding.
There are unclear technical platform decisions: which machines run the functions, the interface type, and whether it should be one-way or multi-purpose.
Production cost cap for the remote is set at 20.5 Euro, and the remote should remain basic and focused on channel switching.
Consensus on project scope and what we are going to make is deferred to the next meeting; there is consensus on the plan and ensuring that user requirements align with the technical functions.
